description: The revision loop over a critique-usability run, whose critique critique-usability delegates to critique-critic: the stop-check continues at iteration 1 and writes a revision brief of the accepted findings, and stops without one at the three-iteration bound.

cases.given: examples/usability/envelope.json, a critique-usability envelope with 1 finding(s) at severity 3 or 4, and examples/usability/dispositions.json, which accepts F-001, F-002, at iteration 1 (the log has no iteration field)
cases.expect: stop-check decides continue, and the brief step writes a revision brief with 2 item(s), F-001, F-002, byte-identical to evals/expected/usability.revision-brief.json

cases.given: the same envelope and log, with the log's iteration set to 3
cases.expect: stop-check decides stop-bound-reached, and no revision brief is written
